title: save_data_use input
description: This application reads or writes this data, for this purpose, with or without AI; or it stopped. Saves a data use (O27). An AI client's use is a draft until a person confirms it; a person's use is confirmed when saved, unless confirm is false. A use whose governing rule is never is refused for everyone (G-25). Widening a confirmed use to write, or turning AI on, ends it and starts a new one, so the earlier decision stays with the earlier use. When the use needs a decision, proposeDecision opens a data-use decision; a person's confirmed use also sends it to the approvers.

dataUseId.description: The use to change, confirm or end. Leave it out to declare a new one; an open use of the same application, domain, location and AI flag is then changed.

applicationId.description: The application that uses the data.

domainKey.description: The data, by its domain. A domain at a declarable level.

locationId.description: Where the application reaches the data, when known.

purpose.description: Why the application needs the data, in one plain sentence.

reachesAi.description: True when the data is sent to an AI model or agent, for grounding, prompts or training.

aiServiceAsSeen.description: The model or service as named.

aiComponentId.description: The AI service, when it is a registered component.

isDeidentified.description: True when only masked or de-identified data is used.

accessApproachKey.description: How the application signs in to the data, from the access-approach list.

startOn.description: When the use starts. Today when left out.

endOn.description: Ends the use on this date. Ending is never refused.

confirm.description: True confirms the use (registered). A person's save confirms unless this is false. An AI client never confirms (G-21).

proposeDecision.description: When the use needs a decision and has none, open a data-use decision about it.

examples.purpose: Writes approved mileage payments into payroll.
